Receptionist attitude is pretty bad, lots of attitude and refuses to speak in English. Horrible customer service skills.

I booked on their website and they’re telling me what I booked is incorrect, their site and their actual availability is not the same.
I didn't like it at all!! I had my dog ​​euthanized! Zero empathy.
I go there from years and they know how to treat your animal..im very satisfied

I am very disappointed with my experience at this veterinary clinic.

During my dog's visit, several products were administered or prescribed, including vaccines and treatments for worms and fleas. Shortly afterward, my dog ​​developed severe diarrhea.

I contacted the clinic to report the situation. They then recommended a canned product containing probiotics. However, despite the packaging stating a satisfaction guarantee with a money-back guarantee, my refund request was denied.

I also requested a refund for the parasite treatment, given the problems that arose after its administration, but this request was also denied.

What particularly disappoints me is the lack of information regarding possible side effects. I would have appreciated being informed that digestive issues could occur so that I could have properly monitored my dog.

In my opinion, the after-sales service and follow-up did not meet my expectations. I am sharing this experience so that other pet owners can make an informed decision.

This veterinary clinic is truly disappointing. It's gone from the best in Ahuntsic to the worst. We've been clients for about 11 years. We got a puppy, Nanook, at the beginning of January. The vaccinations went well. But since then, we had discussed having our dog neutered with the vet around June. At the beginning of May, we called to make an appointment and were told the June schedule wasn't available yet and to call back next week. After several weeks of being strung along, we were given an appointment for June 24th. We told them it was a holiday. But they said they would be open. Today, June 16th, we were told, "Oh, sorry, June 24th is a holiday." So the next available appointment is in August, but be aware that the schedule isn't available yet... The service is truly awful. We're scrambling at the last minute to find another vet. I really miss Dr. Morin.

WARNING!! I took my cat to be spayed when she was about 6 months old. They shaved her two front paws and cut two of her claws too short, so one claw, which was practically nonexistent, was cut right at the joint. It was covered in dried blood. They didn't say anything; I only noticed it at home and realized the wound was poorly stitched. I do not recommend this vet.
Professional and very friendly.

I went to this clinic last year for my cat and found the staff very welcoming. I recommended it to my son for his 16-year-old dog's vaccination, and he was also very satisfied. Very competitive prices and attentive staff. We recommend it.
A veterinarian who truly cares about the well-being of animals and their owners. We've adopted her!
Excellent service and very kind to our furry little darlings ❤️❤️

I take my cat to the Lille Veterinary Clinic and I'm extremely satisfied. All the staff are incredibly kind, attentive, and professional. You feel listened to, reassured, and well supported at every visit. They take the time to explain things clearly, with great gentleness towards the animals. You can tell they truly love their work and care about the animals' well-being. An excellent clinic that I recommend without hesitation! 👍
Kind reception, kind Doctor, they didnt try to sell me anything i didnt need and gave me all the information i needed, thank you very much

I bring my Samoyed dog and my Domestic cat here, and all the vetenarians are so nice and attentive. They take their time with your babies and they do not rush their check-ups. They do very good job in taking your concerns seriously. I will continue bringing my babies here (unless one day, I move far away).

Excellent service! The only reason I'm missing a fifth star is the lack of parking...

I went for a general checkup for my two cats and to get their vaccinations. Getting an appointment was quick! Very good service, reasonable prices in my opinion, see for yourself:

- Consultation $98/cat

- Basic feline vaccination $32.50/cat
- Ringworm PCR (swab to see if my cat has the disease) $159.10
- $40 discount for two pets on my bill
- Total $438 including taxes

I highly recommend this clinic
Very welcoming clinic, professional service and affordable prices. Thank you!
Excellent service, the vet was attentive and friendly with four-legged friends.
Excellent service, reasonable prices

My cat has been taken care of for the past 11 years at this clinic when it was originally owned by Doctor morin. It was always a pleasure and no issue. Now that it’s under new management, the service has changed for the worst. I asked for a copy of my pets file and I was told that I would need to pay $23 to have a transferred to another clinic. I asked the receptionist if it’s possible to give me the file directly as it is my pet and I can bring it myself and they refused insisting that everywhere that you need to pay, despite the gentleman having the papers already printed in his hands, I’m appalled. Stay away from this clinic. They just want your money.

I have a Golden Retriever mix and have been going to this clinic for over three years. The staff is welcoming and courteous. Dr. Sandra Botelho listens attentively and clearly explains everything. She has both the necessary interpersonal skills and expertise. I recommend her without hesitation.
Always loved bringing my baby akita here, even if i move from the neighbourhood i'll bring her here, I never had a bad vet or staff serve me
No equipment to perform an ultrasound. It makes the visit expensive when you have to travel by taxi.
Very good vet

The welcome was very friendly, the staff very professional, they listened attentively and provided accurate information. Nothing but positive things to say, go there without hesitation. No appointment needed for emergencies, just go and they'll take care of you.

Receptionist is just awful. Refused to speak English to me and very cocky attitude. After making my payment he didn't give me a receipt. I realized when I got home. I went back telling him I didn't get a receipt and his answer, we normally don't give unless you ask???? I have never heard of such a thing. He was just awful, his attitude will make this clinic go out of business. The Vet was OK! Again only spoke French, saw I was having difficulty understanding him and then decided to switch to English. Fast forward prescribed some meds for my dog to only forget to give them to me until I reminded him. Not happy with this place at all.
